info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Ecommerce Cart Remove-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Removal API facilitates the removal of items from a user's shopping cart in an online ecommerce platform. This endpoint enables consumers to manage their cart effectively by allowing them to delete specific products, helping to enhance user experience and streamline order management. Typical use cases include situations where customers want to adjust their cart contents before checkout. This API is essential for developers building applications that require dynamic cart management functionalities.

delete.summary: Remove an item from the shopping cart
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to remove a specific item from the shopping cart by its identifier. Provide the item ID to successfully delete it from the user's cart.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to remove an item from the shopping cart. The client must specify the details of the item to be removed, including relevant identifiers, to ensure the correct item is processed.

200.description: Successfully removed the item from the cart.
